summary.text: Ugbodu, “the forest has saved us”, was the first Olukumi town, founded by Yoruba from the Akure kingdom; a second Yoruba group from Owo, the Ologun Uja, joined them in a war with Ohordua and stayed. Its king is the Oloza.

founders.text: Its founders came from the Akure kingdom, led by Kokoroko (Adetola), the elder.
The Ologun Uja, “warring fighters” from Owo, who joined Ugbodu in its war with Ohordua; their leader’s line holds the title Ologun.
